For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war.
Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…
He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…

Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow will be cut off; and he will…
He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

translations.web: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.
translations.bsb: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
translations.kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
translations.asv: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, Oh God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:
